ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile.maps_to: nothing in the sim. Its only consumer is CombatManager.cs:657-664, the turn-1 pass that moves every such card to the BOTTOM of the draw pile before the opening hand is drawn
ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile.issue: The sim's docstring calls this 'cosmetic and not modeled' (enchantments.py:249); it is not cosmetic -- it changes the draw pile's order for the whole combat and, for Imbued specifically, is what keeps the card OUT of the opening hand so that the AutoPrePlay auto-play is the only way it resolves. The MISSING PASS itself is already recorded as audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 21 / guard G14 (rule 3: not re-verdicted, same verdict); this entry records that Imbued is the only implementer in the game and therefore the whole of G14's blast radius, and that the sim's rationale for skipping it is wrong.

ShowAmount.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchantCardType.maps_to: ImbuedEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:255-259) -- `card_type == CardType.SKILL`, matching Imbued.cs:15-18. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered.issue: The sim adds a guard C# does not have. Imbued.cs:20-25 is `if (player == Card.Owner && player.PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1) await CardCmd.AutoPlay(ctx, Card, null);` -- NO pile check, so the card is auto-played from wherever it is, which by CombatManager.cs:657-664 is the BOTTOM OF THE DRAW PILE. The sim requires `self.card in player.hand`, so it fires only when the card happens to be dealt into the opening five -- the very outcome the C# pass exists to prevent. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/enchantment_probes.py imbued`): over seeds 0-19 with a 10-card deck holding one Imbued Defend, the sim's auto-play fired on 7 of 20 openings; the game fires on 20 of 20. LIVE: Imbued is granted by the ported Electric Shrymp relic (relics/electric_shrymp.py:17-21), the sim's auto_play_card searches the draw pile too (combat.py:526-534) so the hand guard is the only thing stopping it, and turn <= 1 is reached in every combat. Distinct from turn_structure G8 (which owns the missing AutoPrePlay PHASE, i.e. WHEN the hook fires) and from G14 (which owns the missing pile pass): this is the hook BODY carrying an extra condition.

guards.what: FOUR-VERB COVERAGE (enchant / upgrade+downgrade / transform / copy) -- stated explicitly so the hole cannot reopen silently. Verb 3, TRANSFORM: CardCmd.Transform (CardCmd.cs:369-451) removes the original from its pile and adds a freshly-built replacement; it never touches Enchantment, and the destroyed original takes its enchantment with it
guards.maps_to: TRANSFORM verdict: FAITHFUL, both engines drop the enchantment. C#: CardCmd.Transform's loop takes `item.GetReplacement(rng)`, calls `item.Original.RemoveFromCurrentPile()` (CardCmd.cs:400) and adds the replacement (CardCmd.cs:437/440); the word Enchantment does not appear anywhere in the method, and neither AfterTransformedFrom nor AfterTransformedTo (CardModel.cs:1625-1631, both empty virtuals -- SovereignBlade is the only override in the source) moves it. So the enchantment dies with the original. SIM: run.transform_card (run.py:406-470) and CardCmd.transform_to_random (cmds.py:415-449) both build the replacement with `make_card(...)`, which carries no enchantment. EXECUTED, this unit: `py -c "import sys,random;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from sts2_rl.run import RunState;from sts2_rl.cards import make_card;from sts2_rl.enchantments import make_enchantment;r=RunState(rng=random.Random(0));c=make_card('defend');r.deck=[c];e=make_enchantment('imbued');e.amount=2;e.attach(c);n=r.transform_card(c,into=make_card('bash'));print(n.id, n.enchantment)"` -> `bash None`, matching C#. The in-combat twin (CardCmd.transform_to_random on a Sharp'd Strike) also prints a replacement with `enchantment=None`. Same result for all 17 ids. COVERAGE TABLE for this unit -- (1) ENCHANT: the CanEnchantCardType hook entry plus the reachability guard above. (2) UPGRADE / DOWNGRADE: cannot bite here, and that is now executed rather than assumed: `py -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from sts2_rl.enchantments import ALL_ENCHANTMENTS, Enchantment;print(sorted(k for k,v in ALL_ENCHANTMENTS.items() if v.attach is not Enchantment.attach))"` -> `['goopy','souls','steady','tezcataras_ember']`. Only those four override attach() to mutate a static card property (exhausts / retain / cost / eternal), so only those four can be undone by the card rebuild that upgrade()/downgrade() performs. This unit is not one of them -- it works through the modify_* hooks, which are read live off the still-attached enchantment -- so upgrade and downgrade are no-ops for it. (3) TRANSFORM: this entry, faithful. (4) COPY: guard EG2, gap. All four verbs are now on the record; before this pass transform and copy were 0/17.

guards.what: EG2: card COPY drops the enchantment. C# CardModel.CreateClone (CardModel.cs:2168) -> MutableClone -> DeepCloneFields re-attaches the source card's enchantment onto the copy -- CardModel.cs:1204-1209 `(EnchantmentModel)Enchantment.ClonePreservingMutability()`, `Enchantment = null`, `EnchantInternal(clone, clone.Amount)` -- and does the same for the Affliction two lines down (1210-1215). CreateClone itself throws unless the card sits in a COMBAT pile (CardModel.cs:2170-2173), so every copy site is a combat-pile copy. The sim's copy sites rebuild the card from its class and carry only the upgrade level.
guards.issue: MECHANISM EG2, one verdict at every site (rule 3). FIVE ported sim copy sites drop the enchantment, each a `type(card)()` / `make_card(card.id)` rebuild plus a re-upgrade loop with no `card.enchantment` carry: cards/trash_heap_cards.py:18-24 `_clone` (Dual Wield, DualWield.cs:35), powers.py:827-830 (JugglingPower.cs:48), relics/music_box.py:46-48 (MusicBox.cs:78), cards/anger.py:36-38 (Anger.cs:27) and relics/burning_sticks.py:30-32 (BurningSticks.cs:49). All five map to a C# `CreateClone()` call, so all five are the same defect. The sim's OTHER copy paths are correct and are what makes this a bug rather than a design choice: relics/bing_bong.py:37 and events/reflections.py:52 use `copy.deepcopy` (the enchantment rides along), relics/paels_growth.py:39-46 re-attaches Clone by hand, and the per-combat deck copy (run.py:1136 `copy.deepcopy`) carries it too. EXECUTED, this unit: `py -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from sts2_rl.cards import make_card;from sts2_rl.cards.trash_heap_cards import _clone;from sts2_rl.enchantments import make_enchantment;c=make_card('defend');e=make_enchantment('imbued');e.amount=2;e.attach(c);print(type(c.enchantment).__name__, _clone(c).enchantment)"` -> `ImbuedEnchantment None`. The same one-liner run over all 17 ids prints `None` for every one of the 16 that any probe card accepts (souls needs an Exhaust card, so it was run against fiend_fire). RULE 6, both legs -- reachability of the copy site for THIS unit: SKILL-only (Imbued.cs:11; executed matrix A/P/S = False/False/True), so the only reachable site is relics/burning_sticks.py:30-32 (the first SKILL exhausted each combat). Every one of the five sites is ported and reachable (Dual Wield from the ported Trash Heap event pool, events/trash_heap.py:17; Anger from the Ironclad common pool; Juggling from cards/juggling.py; Music Box and Burning Sticks are ported relics). LIVENESS: DORMANT. Imbued's two effects are both combat-SETUP effects -- ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile (Imbued.cs:11, consumed by CombatManager.cs:657-664 at combat start) and the turn-1 auto-play (Imbued.cs:20-26 / enchantments.py:261-267) -- and a Burning Sticks copy is minted mid-combat, after both windows have closed. Dormant, not waived (rule 1): it goes live the moment any copy site is reachable at combat start or any Imbued effect becomes turn-agnostic. SECONDARY (false docstring): `_clone`'s docstring claims it "mirrors CreateClone for the sim's needs". It does not -- CreateClone carries the enchantment AND the affliction; `_clone` carries neither. Fifth entry in this stream's false-docstring list.
